purpose: NOT IN subquery (not unnested because of NULL semantics: hashed SubPlan)
sql:
SELECT count(*)
FROM part
WHERE p_partkey NOT IN (SELECT l_partkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_quantity = 50
                        AND l_shipdate >= DATE '1998-01-01')

extra.AI Reason: Aggregate the results of the anti-join to count the remaining parts.
Use a Hash Anti Join to filter out parts that exist in the lineitem subquery.
Full scan of the part table is efficient for the outer relation.
Build a hash table on the filtered lineitem results.
Aggregate to get unique part keys for the anti-join hash table.
Filter lineitem rows based on quantity and shipdate.

differences.text: PostgreSQL evaluates the subquery over (lineitem) as a separate SubPlan (checked for each row) used by Index Only Scan on part using part_pkey, while the AI turns it into an Anti Hash Join (Hash Join of (part) with (lineitem)).
PostgreSQL runs part of the plan in parallel (Gather). The AI plan runs in a single process.

Table part: PostgreSQL uses Index Only Scan on part using part_pkey. The AI uses Seq Scan on part. A sequential scan wins when many rows qualify. An index scan wins when few rows qualify. A bitmap scan sits in between. The AI's reason: "Full scan of the part table is efficient for the outer relation."
Only the PostgreSQL plan has Gather over (lineitem) (collects rows from parallel worker processes).

Only the AI plan has Hash Join of (part) with (lineitem) (builds a hash table on the inner input, then probes it with every outer row). The AI's reason: "Use a Hash Anti Join to filter out parts that exist in the lineitem subquery."
Only the AI plan has Hash over (lineitem) (builds the in-memory hash table for a Hash Join). The AI's reason: "Build a hash table on the filtered lineitem results."
Only the AI plan has Aggregate (Hashed) over (lineitem) (computes aggregates (GROUP BY, SUM, COUNT, ...)). The AI's reason: "Aggregate to get unique part keys for the anti-join hash table."
